asked.text: The king asked: which god was born as whom?

five.text: The five Pandava brothers each carried part of a god: the god of justice, the wind, the gods' king, and the twin horsemen.
The five Pandava brothers each carried part of a god.

karna.text: Karna, born in armour, was part of the sun.

krishna.text: And the god above all gods? Part of him came to earth as Krishna.

kali.text: But dark powers had been born first. Duryodhana, who lit the feud, was born from the spirit of strife.

draupadi.text: A portion of the goddess of fortune rose from an altar: Draupadi.

payoff.text: The wise who hear this do not lose heart in hard times.

cliff.text: And now the king wished to hear his own family's story.

gods.text: The god of justice, the wind, the gods' king, and the twin horsemen.
